items.text: Laba bangabantwana besifunda abenyuka besuka ekuthunjweni kwabathunjwa, uNebukadinesari, inkosi yaseBabele, abathumbela eBabele, babuyela eJerusalema nakwaJuda, kwaba yilowo nalowo emzini wakubo;
abeza noZerubhabheli: ngoJeshuwa, noNehemiya, noSeraya, noRehelaya, noMoridekayi, noBilisani, noMispari, noBhigwayi, noRehumi, noBahana. Inani lamadoda abantwana bakwa-Israyeli:
abantwana bakwaPharosi: yizinkulungwane ezimbili nekhulu namashumi ayisikhombisa nambili;
abantwana bakwaShefathiya: ngamakhulu amathathu namashumi ayisikhombisa nambili;
abantwana bakwa-Aragi: ngamakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi ayisikhombisa nanhlanu;
abantwana bakwaPhahati Mowabi babantwana bakwaJeshuwa noJowabe izinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili neshumi nambili.
Abantwana bakwa-Elamu: yinkulungwane namakhulu amabili namashumi ayisihlanu nane;
abantwana bakwaSathu: ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi amane nanhlanu;
abantwana bakwaZakayi: ngamakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi ayisithupha;
abantwana bakwaBani: ngamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi amane nambili;
abantwana bakwaBebayi: ngamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi amabili nantathu;
abantwana bakwa-Ashigadi: yinkulungwane namakhulu amabili namashumi amabili nambili;
abantwana bakwa-Adonikamu: ngamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi ayisithupha nesithupha;
abantwana bakwaBigwayi: yizinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi ayisihlanu nesithupha;
abantwana bakwa-Adini: ngamakhulu amane namashumi ayisihlanu nane;
abantwana bakwa-Atheri kaHezekiya: ngamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye nesishiyagalombili.
Abantwana bakwaBesayi: ngamakhulu amathathu namashumi amabili nantathu;
abantwana bakwaJora: yikhulu neshumi nambili;
abantwana bakwaHashumi: ngamakhulu amabili namashumi amabili nantathu;
abantwana baseGibari: ngamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye nanhlanu.
Abantwana baseBetlehema: yikhulu namashumi amabili nantathu;
amadoda aseNetofa: ngamashumi ayisihlanu nesithupha;
amadoda ase-Anathoti: yikhulu namashumi amabili nesishiyagalombili;
abantwana bakwa-Asmaweti: ngamashumi amane nambili;
abantwana baseKiriyatharimi, neKefira, neBeyeroti, amakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi amane nantathu.
Abantwana baseRama naseGaba ngamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi amabili nanye;
amadoda aseMigimasi: yikhulu namashumi amabili nambili;
amadoda aseBethele nase-Ayi: ngamakhulu amabili namashumi amabili nantathu;
abantwana baseNebo: ngamashumi ayisihlanu nambili;
abantwana baseMagibhishi: yikhulu namashumi ayisihlanu nesithupha;
abantwana bomunye u-Elamu inkulungwane namakhulu amabili namashumi ayisihlanu nane;
abantwana bakwaHarimi: ngamakhulu amathathu namashumi amabili;
abantwana baseLodi, naseHadidi, nase-Ono: ngamakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Abantwana baseJeriko: ngamakhulu amathathu namashumi amane nanhlanu;
abantwana baseSenagi: yizinkulungwane ezintathu namakhulu ayisithupha namashumi amathathu;
Abapristi: abantwana bakwaJedaya bendlu kaJeshuwa: amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi ayisikhombisa nantathu.
Abantwana bakwa-Imeri: yinkulungwane namashumi ayisihlanu nambili;
abantwana bakwaPhasguri: yinkulungwane namakhulu amabili namashumi amane nesikhombisa;
abantwana bakwaHarimi, inkulungwane neshumi nesikhombisa;
AmaLevi: abantwana bakwaJeshuwa noKadimiyeli babantwana bakwaHodawa: ngamashumi ayisikhombisa nane.
Abahlabeleli: abantwana bakwa-Asafa: yikhulu namashumi amabili nesishiyagalombili.

Abantwana babalindisango: abantwana bakwaShalumi, abantwana bakwa-Atheri, abantwana bakwaTalimoni, abantwana bakwa-Akubi, abantwana bakwaHatita, abantwana bakwaShobayi, ikhulu namashumi amathathu nesishiyagalolunye.
AmaNethini: abantwana bakwaSiha, abantwana bakwaHasufa, abantwana bakwaThabawoti,
abantwana bakwaKerosi, abantwana bakwaSiyaha, abantwana bakwaPhadoni,
abantwana bakwaLibana, abantwana bakwaHagaba, abantwana bakwa-Akubi,
abantwana bakwaHagabi, nabantwana bakwaSalimayi, nabantwana bakwaHanani,
abantwana bakwaGideli, nabantwana bakwaGahari, nabantwana bakwaReyaya,
abantwana bakwaResini, abantwana bakwaNekoda, abantwana bakwaGasamu,
abantwana bakwa-Uza, abantwana bakwaPhaseha, abantwana bakwaBesayi,
abantwana bakwa-Asna, nabantwana bakwaMehunimi, nabantwana bakwaNefusimu,
abantwana bakwaBakibuki, abantwana bakwaHakufa, abantwana bakwaHarihuri,
abantwana bakwaBaziluti, abantwana bakwaMehida, abantwana bakwaHarsa,
abantwana bakwaBarkosi, abantwana bakwaSisera, abantwana bakwaTama,
abantwana bakwaNesiya, abantwana bakwaHatifa.
Abantwana bezinceku zikaSolomoni: abantwana bakwaSothayi, abantwana bakwaSofereti, abantwana bakwaPeruda,
abantwana bakwaJayela, abantwana bakwaDarkoni, abantwana bakwaGideli,
abantwana bakwaShefathiya, abantwana bakwaHathili, abantwana bakwaPogereti Sebayimi, abantwana bakwa-Ami.
Zonke izinceku zethempelini nabantwana bezinceku zikaSolomoni zazingamakhulu amathathu namashumi ayisishiyagalolunye nambili.
Yilabo abenyuka besuka eThelimela, naseTheliharisa, naseKherubi, nase-Adani, nase-Imeri, kepha babengenakukhombisa indlu kayise nenzalo yabo, uma babengabakwa-Israyeli.
Abantwana bakwaDelaya, abantwana bakwaThobiya, abantwana bakwaNekoda, amakhulu ayisithupha namashumi amahlanu nambili.
Kubantwana babapristi: abantwana bakwaHabaya, abantwana bakwaKoshi, abantwana bakwaBarizilayi; owathatha umfazi emadodakazini kaBarizilayi wakwaGileyadi, wabizwa ngegama lawo.
Bafuna umbhalo wabo phakathi kwababalwayo ngokohlu lozalo, kepha awafunyanwa; ngakho-ke, njengoba bengcolile, baxoshwa ebupristini.
Umbusi wathi kubo ukuthi bangadli izinto ezingcwelengcwele, kuze kuvele umpristi one-Urimi neThumimi.
Ibandla lonke lindawonye laliyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amane nambili namakhulu amathathu namashumi ayisithupha;

ngaphandle kwezinceku zabo nezincekukazi zabo, ezaziyizinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa namakhulu amathathu namashumi amathathu nesikhombisa, futhi kwakukhona phakathi kwabo abahlabeleli nabahlabeleli abangamakhulu amabili.
Amahhashi abo ayengamakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi amathathu nesithupha; iminyuzi yabo ingamakhulu amabili namashumi amane nanhlanu;
amakamela abo ibingamakhulu amane namashumi amathathu nanhlanu; izimbongolo izinkulungwane eziyisithupha namakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi amabili.
Abanye bezinhloko zezindlu zoyise, lapho besendlini kaJehova eseJerusalema, bahlabela ize ukuze indlu kaNkulunkulu imiswe endaweni yayo.
Banikela engcebweni yomsebenzi amadarike ayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisithupha egolide namamane ayizinkulungwane ezinhlanu esiliva nezingubo eziyikhulu zabapristi ngokwamandla abo.
Abapristi namaLevi nabanye abantu nabahlabeleli nabalindisango namaNethini bahlala emizini yabo, no-Israyeli wonke emizini yabo.
